en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a small village set among rolling hills and dense forests. Farm fields and meadows occupy the foreground, while scattered houses and larger buildings sit on gently rising slopes. The upper left corner bears printed German text identifying the place as Bärenfels in the Eastern Ore Mountains (Ost-Erzgebirge). The overall style and printing resemble an early- to mid-20th-century photographic postcard.
